text:
maria: Heads up — saw a sudden activation surge for Nebula’s trial cluster, ~3x expected. Thought we should preemptively lock budget alerts and QBR notes. Anyone on call for quick triage?

kevin: saw it. pulling spend graph now. may be high-embedding usage from /batch-embed job. cc @anika

anika: thanks — I’m on train but can jump in 5. do we have a customer contact? renewal is Feb so flagging risk.

eli: pinged product: customer says they enabled "bulk ingest" (not aligned with onboarding plan). Could be misconfig of batching.

maria: capture for QBR: token growth + unexpected batch -> propose temporary quota + enablement walkthrough. Also we should check dedupe cache settings.

cost-bot: alert: account=nebula | 3.1x baseline | projected monthly spend +420% | threshold=manual

kevin: quick query I ran:
```
SELECT sum(tokens) FROM usage
WHERE account='nebula' AND day >= '2026-03-15';
```
returns 4.2M tokens/day last 24h (normal 1.3M).

anika: ok recommend: 1) set soft limit to 50% above baseline 2) schedule 30-min enablement with CS + onboarding engineer 3) run eval on top prompts to check for runaway loops. I'll draft email.

eli: I'll add to QBR notes under 'Onboarding gaps' and tag renewal-risk low/med depending on fix time.

maria: draft of customer-facing note (send after we set limit):
'Hey team — noticed a spike from bulk-ingest config. We've set a temporary quota to prevent runaway spend. Can we schedule 30m tomorrow to review batch size and KV caching? We'll also share quick best-practices docs.'

kevin: created a short playbook snippet in #docs-runbooks: link https://redwood.internal/runbooks/preemptive-activation-surge (small doc) — copied relevant thresholds:
```
soft_limit_pct=150
hard_limit_pct=300
monitor_window=6h
```

anika: capturing follow-ups: @eli to send QBR line, @kevin to attach spend graph, @maria to own customer email, I'll run post-call recommendations. tagging renewal-owner @julian

maria: thanks all. I'll set the soft limit now and send initial note. If anyone sees escalation to hard limit, ping immediately. :thumbsup:
